nodes.text: You hung a gate against a voted work. The Charter calls that obstruction and bills it at sixty a season, and I am the one who has to write it. Pay it or do not. The gate stays hung either way, and so does the bill.

choices.text: I will not pay a bill for a gate.

nodes.text: Sixty, to the counter, and your name comes out of the obstruction column when it is counted. It goes back in next season if the gate is still hung. It will be.
Then it is in the book as owed. The book is patient. So am I.
Then it stands in the book. The book is patient. So am I.
